scope: Restore Publish 14.1 ground faction-standing and cloning authority, remove NGE GCW kill-score and cloning-sickness precedence, and close the remaining level-gated XP callback.

findings: A faction NPC kill awards one highest-damage player standing from the defeated creature's authored level multiplied by its faction combat factor; enemies gain that amount while the defeated faction and eligible allies lose twice that amount.

An opposing non-duel player kill grants the killer 30 points with their own faction, removes 45 with the opposing faction, and removes 45 from the victim's own faction without player-level, rank, profession, overt-status, Luck, or daily-kill scaling.

Cloning applies 100 wounds to Health, Action, Mind, and battle fatigue when the chosen facility is not predesignated, plus one-percent insured or five-percent uninsured item decay. Publish 14.1 has no cloning-sickness buff or level-priced cure layer.
